weapons.name: F1 police revolver, .357 Mag, 3" barrel, fixed sights
weapons.source_note: TWIST NOT STATED FOR THIS MODEL. The manufacturer's Manurhin revolver page lists the Manurhin range (MR73 Gendarmerie, MR73 Sport, MR 38 Match, MR 32 Match) and no F1 model appears on it or in a search of the manufacturer site. The Manurhin MR73 owner's manual and the printed Manurhin catalogue likewise give no F1 twist. The F1 could not be identified as a catalogued Chapuis/Manurhin model with a published twist, so the MR73 line value is deliberately not applied to it. The corpus lead (406 mm) is not copied.

weapons.name: MR 73 Gendarmerie police revolver, .357 Mag, 4" barrel
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification table, column 'Pas de rayures', row 'MR73 Gendarmerie 4"': '6 rayures / grooves RH twist at 1 turn in 476mm rate = 18¾".' The manufacturer states 476 mm directly, so no inch conversion is needed. 6 grooves, right hand.

weapons.name: MR 73 GIGN duty revolver, .357 Mag, 5.25" barrel, GIGN issue
weapons.source_note: The GIGN revolver is an MR 73 variant. The manufacturer specification table gives one twist for the whole MR 73 line, row 'MR73 Sport 5" ¼' (the 5.25 inch barrel): '6 rayures / grooves RH twist at 1 turn in 476mm rate = 18¾".' The same page states 'le G.I.G.N. et le R.A.I.D. ainsi que la Police Nationale française, avaient choisi le MR73 comme arme de dotation'. The table has no separate GIGN row, so the 476 mm figure is quoted from the MR 73 line, not from a GIGN-specific row.

weapons.name: MR 73 Sport match revolver, .357 Mag, 6" barrel, adjustable sights
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification table, column 'Pas de rayures', row 'MR73 Sport 6"': '6 rayures / grooves RH twist at 1 turn in 476mm rate = 18¾".' 6 grooves, right hand.

weapons.name: MR 73 Revolver
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer product page for the MR 73. Every row of the 'Pas de rayures' column states '6 rayures / grooves RH twist at 1 turn in 476mm rate = 18¾".' (rows MR73 Gendarmerie 3"/4", MR73 Sport 4", 5" ¼, Sport HB, 6", 8" and the MR 38 / MR 32 Match). The MR 73 line twist is therefore 476 mm, 6 grooves right hand. Note the manufacturer value differs from both the corpus lead (406 mm) and the standard value (457 mm) supplied in the worklist.

weapons.name: Model 1894 CSBL stainless .357 Mag, 16.5" barrel, synthetic stock
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer product page feature list: '16 1/2" barrel 1:16" twist rate'. 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm. Groove count is not stated for this model.

weapons.name: Model 336 Dark Series black synthetic, 16.5" barrel, M-Lok handguard
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification table for model 70902, 'Caliber 30-30 Win': 'Twist | 1:11" RH' and 'Grooves | 6'. 1 turn in 11 in = 279.4 mm. This differs from the corpus lead (305 mm, 1:12) and from the standard value (254 mm, 1:10).

weapons.name: Model 70P Papoose takedown .22 LR, backpack
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification table for the Papoose take-down model 70PSS (the stainless Papoose, same take-down rifle and barrel as the 70P): 'Barrel 16.25" stainless steel with Micro-Groove® rifling (16 grooves). Twist Rate 1:16" r.h.' 1 turn in 16 in = 406.4 mm, 16 Micro-Groove grooves, right hand. The published data sheet is for the 70PSS, not for a separately labelled 70P data sheet; the barrel and take-down action are the same.

weapons.name: TAC-300 .300 Winchester Magnum
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification list: 'Chambered in .300 Winchester Magnum' and 'Twist 1:10"'. 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm. The corpus lead (254 mm) agrees; the standard value (508 mm) does not apply to this rifle.

weapons.name: TAC-308 .308 Winchester
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification list: '.308 Winchester Twist 1:10"' (and separately '6.5 Creedmoor Twist 1:8"'). 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm for the .308 Winchester chambering.

weapons.name: TAC-338 .338 Lapua Magnum
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer specification list: '.338 Lapua Mag Twist 1:10"'. 1 turn in 10 in = 254.0 mm. The corpus lead (237 mm) is not supported by the manufacturer.

weapons.name: Black Widow Single-action revolver
weapons.source_note: TWIST NOT STATED. The manufacturer product page gives only 'Black Widow w/ Fixed Sights – 2″ Barrel .22 Magnum' with barrel length, capacity and weight; it publishes no twist rate. A search of the manufacturer site for 'twist' returns 'No results found', and the NAA mini-revolver manual states no twist. No citable twist exists, so the corpus lead (406 mm) is not copied.

weapons.name: Ranger Ii Single-action top-break revolver
weapons.source_note: TWIST NOT STATED. The manufacturer product page gives only '22 Magnum – 1 5 / 8 ” Barrel .22 Magnum Long Rifle Conversion Cylinder available as NAA-22MC-R 5-Shot'; it publishes no twist rate. A search of the manufacturer site for 'twist' returns 'No results found'. No citable twist exists, so the corpus lead (305 mm) is not copied.

weapons.name: Hush .300BLK 16"
weapons.source_note: TWIST NOT STATED / MODEL NOT FOUND. The manufacturer's complete product list holds no 'Hush' model. The NEMO Arms lines are OMEN, XO, Battle-Light, FX, Mongoose and NX; no Internet Archive capture of nemoarms.com contains a Hush product either. A twist cannot be attributed to a product the manufacturer does not publish, so the corpus lead (178 mm) is not copied.

weapons.name: Omen .300WM 24"
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer product page for 'OMEN™ Watchman™ .300 Win Mag', specification table: 'Barrel Length: 24 in' and 'Barrel PROOF Research 24” carbon fiber wrapped barrel 1:8 twist'. The page also lists 'Compatible with (ammo) .300 WIN MAG'. 1 turn in 8 in = 203.2 mm. The 24 inch .300 Win Mag OMEN is the Watchman. The corpus lead (254 mm) matches the older 22 inch OMEN Standard and Match (archived pages give '300 Win Mag, 1/10 Twist'), not this 24 inch model.

weapons.name: Sentinel .308 18"
weapons.source_note: TWIST NOT STATED / MODEL NOT FOUND. The manufacturer's complete product list holds no 'Sentinel' model. The NEMO Arms .308 models are XO, the Battle Rifle and the Dakkar; no Internet Archive capture of nemoarms.com contains a Sentinel product either. A twist cannot be attributed to a product the manufacturer does not publish, so the corpus lead (254 mm) is not copied.

weapons.name: Diplomat Pistol
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer product page, Specifications section: 'Barrel • 7.94” 300Blackout 416R Stainless with 1:7 twist'. 1 turn in 7 in = 177.8 mm.

weapons.name: Ghetto Blaster SBR
weapons.source_note: Manufacturer product page (archived), specification list: 'Barrel: 7.94″ 300 Blackout Stainless with 1:7 twist'. 1 turn in 7 in = 177.8 mm.
